baseline_method: Compile baseline view.cc with the recorded Release command and replace that object in a copied local-view archive; other linked objects and benchmark remain identical.
method: Three alternating baseline/lazy-accessor runs per corpus; benchmark performs 100000 integer lookups over mixed 25% integer and 75% boolean records.
limits: Synthetic local corpora; lookup wall time; samples vary and do not establish a stable speedup, fleet capacity, CPU energy or application latency.
